title: Modern Home 3 Miles To Downtown
description:
Modern, luxury, trendy home located 3 miles from Downtown in Sylvan Heights.

Enjoy 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, 1 half bathroom, 1 King and 5 Queen beds.  Private 2 car garages, 2 tiered deck-perfect for entertaining off of the main level living area, & an elegant master suite that features sliding glass doors leading to a private balcony overlooking the downtown city skyline! 3 miles to the Downtown & Walk able to all of the amenities of Charlotte Ave.

The space
The Home:

Inside this spacious home, the first level offers two bedrooms and one bath along with a washer and dryer, on the second level you will find a beautiful modern kitchen, a standalone island with counter-tops with plenty of seating around the island. Brand new modern kitchen and app
liances.  For your entertainment needs, a 60-inch 4k TV is mounted for your enjoyment from comfortable sofas.  

On the third floor will also find the master bedroom - furnished with two queen beds and a full bath and your own private deck!

This house has plenty of space to rest after an incredible day out in Music City. The master bedroom is huge and we have set up two queen-sized beds to further accommodate your large groups. 

Of course, don't forget! We have 2 huge decks with spanning views of Downtown Nashville! So, get ready to explore Music City during the day & enjoy the beautiful skyline of Nashville from the deck at night!

Guest access
You`ll have 100% private access to this home during your entire stay, except for one closet that I keep for personal belongings and supplies

Other things to note
If you need luggage drop off for early arrival that can be arranged.
